jobs.description_text: 负责车辆运动学控制系统软件架构设计以及和自动驾驶、底盘控制、扭矩控制的系统接口定义 Responsible for vehicle motion control system software architecture design and define interface with ADAS, Chassis and powertrain system. 负责VDC车辆横向控制、车辆动态控制和扭矩分配软件开发 Responsible system integration and control algorithm design, including VDC vehicle lateral control, vehicle dynamic control and torque distribution, support software development. 根据VMC系统层级功能需求和功能规范，编写软件需求，算法开发，完成系统集成测试。 Responsible for VMC system level function definition and function spec, support SW requirement, algorithm development, finish system integration test. 作为客户项目技术接口人，制定项目开发计划，协调内部资源，管理客户需求和工程变更. Acting as customer technical interface, define project plan, coordinate internal resources, responsible for requirement management and change request. 3年以上车辆底盘专业和相关工作经历，对底盘的制动/转向/悬架的控制（主要是横向底盘控制算法）有深入的了解 3 years major in Vehicle Chassis Engineering or related fields with relevant work experience. Possess in-depth knowledge of chassis control systems including braking, steering, and suspension (primarily lateral chassis control VDC algorithms). 系统和标定能力较强，能定义具体的底盘动力域融合的架构和功能开发策略，指导或进行软件开发； Strong capabilities in system engineering and calibration. Expertise in major cooperative motion control functions, specifically Vehicle VDC Pre-Stabilization Control (Feedforward + Feedback), Variable Driving Characteristics. 具备一定的Matlab Simulink能力 Certain level capacity of Matlab Simulink 熟悉车辆横向前馈控制算法优先 Familiar with lateral “feedforward control” is preferred. 熟悉车辆动力学模型以及车辆参数估算（例如参考车速，路面附着系数，质量，坡度，6DIMU姿态估算等）； Familiar with vehicle model and vehicle parameters estimation, for example vehicle reference speed, road surface adhesion factor, vehicle mass, road slop, 6D IMU attitude estimation. 熟悉PID、MPC、LQR等一种或多种车辆控制方法； Familiar with PID, MPC, LQR jobs.description_text: We are seeking an accomplished and visionary AI Engineer to drive the transformation of our manufacturing systems through cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies. This role requires deep technical expertise in Computer Vision and Deep Learning, coupled with capabilities in Agentic AI, to translate AI technology into measurable business value. As a core member of our digital transformation initiative, working closely with product managers, solution architects, full-stack developers, and data engineers, you will design and deliver AI solutions. Requirement Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders and plant teams to understand use-case requirements and pain points, translating them into robust technical specifications. CV & Deep Learning Development: Design, train, and deploy classical vision algorithms and deep learning models for industrial inspection and automation, balancing accuracy, robustness, and real-time performance. Agentic AI Solutions: Develop and implement Agentic AI workflows leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve manufacturing problems, such as intelligent document processing, automated reporting, and complex decision support. Time-series & Multimodal Data: Process and analyze time-series sensor data alongside visual data to build comprehensive AI solutions for predictive maintenance and process optimization, supporting broader factory AI initiatives. Deployment & Integration: Partner with engineering teams to deploy AI models from PoC to production environments, including edge computing integration on the manufacturing line. This position is ideal for individuals who are passionate about industrial innovation, capable of bridging the gap between research and operations, and ready to shape the future of intelligent manufacturing. Skills CV & Deep Learning: Proficient in computer vision and deep learning algorithms (e.g., object detection, semantic/instance segmentation, anomaly detection); familiar with modern architectures and frameworks. Agentic AI: Solid understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex); experience in building LLM-driven agents for task planning and tool usage is a strong plus. Data & Math: Familiarity with time-series data processing and feature engineering. Solid foundation in statistics, linear algebra, and numerical optimization. Programming & Engineering: Proficient programming skills with good engineering practices; fluent in Python (preferred) or C++; experience with model optimization and edge deployment is a plus. Communication: Strong ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Excellent communication skills to explain AI topics to non-technical stakeholders; working proficiency in English (spoken and written). Experience Hands-on experience developing proof-of-concept (PoC) or prototype AI models (internship or academic research projects count). Proven experience in Computer Vision projects; experience with LLM-based Agent applications is highly desirable. Experience in applied AI or advanced analytics within industrial or manufacturing-related scenarios is a significant plus. Experience participating in AI solution design or feasibility studies, from problem definition to conceptual solution architecture is a plus. Experience working with cross-functional teams (e.g., product, IT, OT, data teams) to translate business problems into AI-driven approaches is a plus. Education Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field (fresh graduates are welcome); OR Bachelor’s degree in the above fields with 2+ years of relevant working experience. Strong ability to read and analyze technical and research literature. Formal training or coursework related to deep learning, decision systems, or industrial informatics is a plus.

jobs.description_text: 负责前视摄像头单元中车道感知算法的研发与迭代，支撑L2/L2+辅助驾驶功能在量产项目中的落地。 设计基于Transformer架构的轻量化车道检测模型，并针对车规级嵌入式芯片的算力限制进行专项优化。 提升算法在复杂光照、遮挡、车道线磨损等挑战场景下的检测鲁棒性，有效解决实际道路中的长尾问题。 完成模型量化与嵌入式平台部署工作，确保量产环境下实时性与精度的平衡。 硕士及以上学历，2年以上自动驾驶或ADAS感知算法开发经验。 深入理解Transformer/CNN网络结构，熟练使用PyTorch框架，熟悉BEV感知或车道检测的主流方法。 具备模型量化、剪枝等轻量化部署经验，熟悉地平线、TDA4等嵌入式平台者优先。 扎实的Python和C++编程能力，良好的工程实现习惯，具备优秀的问题分析与沟通协作能力。

jobs.description_text: 1. 负责雷达/摄像头/域控等产品里场景分析、行为预测、决策规划模块的开发： • 包括道路模型融合、交通参与者行为预测、自车行为决策规划等模块的开发 • 相关模块和系统的性能KPI评估，问题分析和优化 2. 支持相关工具的搭建、开发： • 包括可视化分析工具，数据挖掘，KPI评估工具和仿真工具 1. 学历与专业‌： • 硕士及以上学历‌，计算机/自动化/电子工程/信息工程/车辆工程/数学/物理等专业‌ 2. 工作背景： • 候选人的背景可以是行为决策规划，雷达感知，AEX(AEB/AES)功能开发，测试，系统 • 或者其他对智能驾驶方向有热情，软件开发能力较强的候选人 3. 技术能力‌： • 精通C++，Python，熟悉Matlab • 熟悉AUTOSAR架构及嵌入式开发 • 具备AEX（AEB/AES）开发经验，熟悉开发交付的完整过程者优先 • 熟悉道路模型及其融合的算法，熟悉行为预测，决策规划相关常用算法者优先 • 熟悉雷达感知，了解常用的感知融合算法，常见问题及解决方向者优先 • 具备ADAS量产项目开发交付经验，熟悉L2/L2++的功能链路，熟悉ISO 26262等功能安全流程者优先 4. 软性要求‌： • 英语流利，可以进行技术文档撰写与会议沟通 • 灵活高效，积极主动，责任心强，学习能力强，善于解决问题和协作沟通 • 具备较好的文档能力和复盘的习惯

jobs.description_text: We are seeking an accomplished and visionary AI Engineer to drive the transformation of our manufacturing systems through cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies. This role requires deep technical expertise in Computer Vision and Deep Learning, coupled with capabilities in Agentic AI, to translate AI technology into measurable business value. As a core member of our digital transformation initiative, working closely with product managers, solution architects, full-stack developers, and data engineers, you will design and deliver AI solutions. Requirement Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders and plant teams to understand use-case requirements and pain points, translating them into robust technical specifications. CV & Deep Learning Development: Design, train, and deploy classical vision algorithms and deep learning models for industrial inspection and automation, balancing accuracy, robustness, and real-time performance. Agentic AI Solutions: Develop and implement Agentic AI workflows leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve manufacturing problems, such as intelligent document processing, automated reporting, and complex decision support. Time-series & Multimodal Data: Process and analyze time-series sensor data alongside visual data to build comprehensive AI solutions for predictive maintenance and process optimization, supporting broader factory AI initiatives. Deployment & Integration: Partner with engineering teams to deploy AI models from PoC to production environments, including edge computing integration on the manufacturing line. This position is ideal for individuals who are passionate about industrial innovation, capable of bridging the gap between research and operations, and ready to shape the future of intelligent manufacturing. Skills CV & Deep Learning: Proficient in computer vision and deep learning algorithms (e.g., object detection, semantic/instance segmentation, anomaly detection); familiar with modern architectures and frameworks. Agentic AI: Solid understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex); experience in building LLM-driven agents for task planning and tool usage is a strong plus. Data & Math: Familiarity with time-series data processing and feature engineering. Solid foundation in statistics, linear algebra, and numerical optimization. Programming & Engineering: Proficient programming skills with good engineering practices; fluent in Python (preferred) or C++; experience with model optimization and edge deployment is a plus. Communication: Strong ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Excellent communication skills to explain AI topics to non-technical stakeholders; working proficiency in English (spoken and written). Experience Hands-on experience developing proof-of-concept (PoC) or prototype AI models (internship or academic research projects count). Proven experience in Computer Vision projects; experience with LLM-based Agent applications is highly desirable. Experience in applied AI or advanced analytics within industrial or manufacturing-related scenarios is a significant plus. Experience participating in AI solution design or feasibility studies, from problem definition to conceptual solution architecture is a plus. Experience working with cross-functional teams (e.g., product, IT, OT, data teams) to translate business problems into AI-driven approaches is a plus. Education Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field (fresh graduates are welcome); OR Bachelor’s degree in the above fields with 2+ years of relevant working experience. Strong ability to read and analyze technical and research literature. Formal training or coursework related to deep learning, decision systems, or industrial informatics is a plus.

jobs.description_text: 负责基于AK2超声波传感器的USS感知系统架构设计、核心算法研发与下一代算法创新，涵盖信号处理、目标检测跟踪、分类识别等核心模块。 负责量产客户项目中USS感知模块的系统集成、适配标定、Corner Case根因分析与缺陷闭环，遵循ASPICE流程输出高质量技术设计文档与接口控制文件。
